title: Will o' the Wisp
cannotDealEmptyColExists: Fill every empty column before dealing

tutorial.stockPile: Stock pile (31 cards). Click to deal one card to each column. All columns must contain cards. The final deal places the remaining three cards in the leftmost columns.
tutorial.tableau: Seven columns with three face-up cards each. Build descending runs regardless of suit; same-suit runs can be moved together and K-to-A runs are removed.
tutorial.completedSuits: Number of completed suits. Complete all 4 to win.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

frontendHint.completeSuit: A suit sequence is nearly complete — focus on finishing it
frontendHint.buildSameSuit: A same-suit build move is available
frontendHint.revealFaceDown: Move cards to open a column for another run
frontendHint.useEmptyColumn: An empty column is available — use it to reorganize
frontendHint.dealFromStock: No obvious moves — try dealing from the stock

scoreRule: Starts at {{start}}, -{{penalty}} per move, +{{bonus}} per completed suit
